### Steps to reproduce issue


The script below creates and drops a callback group over and over again. 

The baseline mode runs the test with no callback group creation. 
The test mode runs the test with callback group creation. 

`
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

#include "rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp"

namespace
{

long rss_kb()
{
  std::ifstream f("/proc/self/status");
  std::string line;
  while (std::getline(f, line)) {
    if (line.rfind("VmRSS:", 0) == 0) {
      return std::stol(line.substr(6));
    }
  }
  return -1;
}

void usage(const char * prog)
{
  std::cerr << "usage: " << prog << " <baseline|test> [iters=30000] [warmup=2000]\n";
}

}

int main(int argc, char ** argv)
{
  rclcpp::init(argc, argv);
  if (argc < 2) {
    usage(argv[0]);
    return 2;
  }
  const std::string mode = argv[1];
  const int iters = argc > 2 ? std::atoi(argv[2]) : 30000;
  const int warm = argc > 3 ? std::atoi(argv[3]) : 2000;
  if (mode != "baseline" && mode != "test") {
    usage(argv[0]);
    return 2;
  }

  auto node = std::make_shared<rclcpp::Node>("cbg_test");

  auto step = [&]() {
      if (mode == "test") {
        auto group = node->create_callback_group(
      rclcpp::CallbackGroupType::MutuallyExclusive, false);
      }
    };

  for (int i = 0; i < warm; ++i) {
    step();
  }

  const long start = rss_kb();
  std::cout << "mode=" << mode << " warmup=" << warm << " start_rss_kb=" << start << std::endl;

  for (int i = 1; i <= iters; ++i) {
    step();
  }

  const long end = rss_kb();
  std::cout << "RESULT mode=" << mode << " iters=" << iters << " growth_kb=" << (end - start)
            << " bytes_per_iter=" << (1024.0 * (end - start) / iters) << std::endl;

  rclcpp::shutdown();
  return 0;
}
`

### Expected behavior

The memory footprint should not grow. 

### Actual behavior

The growth is around 304 bytes per iteration. 

### Additional information

In `node_base.cpp` the `create_callback_group` builds the group and then adds it to a vector called calback_groups. This vector holds `CallbackGroup::WeakPtr`. Nothing ever removes from this group. It appears that enties of similar lifecyles pune when updates are made to the container. Is there a way we can add callback group to do something similar?

FYI @SteveMacenski
